messages:
maria (Design): quick copy/a11y check on the delete confirmation modal — current primary button reads 'Delete' and the secondary reads 'Cancel'. screen reader reads the primary as 'Confirm'. users might not get the action context. :thinking_face:
lee (Product): i saw one user test where they hesitated because 'Delete' had no object (delete what?). maybe add the target.
nina (Frontend): we inherited a modal pattern that uses a generic `aria-label` prop and it was set to 'Confirm'. we can change it but want to agree on copy first.
sam (a11y): recommendation: visible primary label should be explicit (e.g., 'Delete model version') and aria-label should match exactly. also add `aria-describedby` referencing the explanatory text in the modal so SR users hear the consequence.
maria (Design): propose microcopy: 
```
Heading: "Delete model version"
Body: "This action permanently removes the selected model version from the deployment. It cannot be undone."
Primary (danger): "Delete version"
Primary aria-label: "Delete model version"
Secondary: "Cancel"
```
lee (Product): i like "Delete version" — short but paired with the heading/body it's clear. Agree on aria-label matching.
nina (Frontend): i'll implement matching `aria-label` and add `id` on the body paragraph for `aria-describedby`. also will ensure the primary button has `data-danger` for styling not just color.
sam (a11y): also make sure the modal sets `role="dialog"` and focuses the close or the cancel button on open, and returns focus to the trigger after close. add a live region for success/failure messages that announces the result.
maria (Design): small phrasing nit for the body: change "It cannot be undone." -> "This cannot be undone." reads better as a continuation.
lee (Product): also add a short undo affordance in the toast: "Version deleted. Undo" rather than just 'Deleted'. so users get a recover path.
nina (Frontend): quick question — should the toast Undo be a button or link? a11y best practice?
sam (a11y): make it a button with role button and ensure it's focusable. avoid auto-focusing the toast; let it be announced. provide `aria-live="polite"` on the region.
maria (Design): final copy for the toast: "Version deleted. Undo" (button text: "Undo delete") and `aria-label` for button: "Undo delete".
ux-bot: reminder: update Figma component `Modal / Danger Confirm` and the copy doc: https://figma.mock/redwood/modal-dangers (tag design).
nina (Frontend): PR opened: #4239 — updates modal copy, adds aria-describedby, returns focus to trigger, and toast with undo. includes unit tests + cypress regression for focus return.
maria (Design): thanks — will review PR and update the copy table. tagging @sam for final a11y sign-off. :sparkles:
sam (a11y): will run NVDA/VoiceOver checks after PR merges. also suggest a small e2e step to assert the live region message text.
lee (Product): thanks team — let's ship to canary after tests pass.
ux-bot: deployment queued: canary for `frontend/modals/danger-confirm` at 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z."
